name: difnote
description: Review the diff of what changed in the folders Claude works in since you last looked, write a note on any line or hunk, and get your notes in the prompt to edit and send back

fileIcons.title: File icons
fileIcons.description: A Nerd Font icon before each file, in its language's color; turn off if your terminal's font has none

addedColor.title: Added color
addedColor.description: How many lines a file or hunk adds: a theme role such as success (the default) or diffAddedWord, or a color: #7ccf8a, rgb(124,207,138), ansi256(114) or ansi:green

removedColor.title: Removed color
removedColor.description: How many lines a file or hunk removes: a theme role such as error (the default) or diffRemovedWord, or a color: #e06c75, rgb(224,108,117), ansi256(167) or ansi:red

noteColor.title: Note color
noteColor.description: Your notes in the pane: a theme role such as suggestion (the default), claude or warning, or a color: #7aa2f7, rgb(122,162,247), ansi256(110) or ansi:cyan

quietColor.title: Quiet color
quietColor.description: Folders, line numbers and hints: a theme role such as inactive (the default, Claude Code's color for hints) or subtle, or a color
